result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal list, a nonsensical '-0%' discount badge, and a partially cut-off category filter.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the 'Fastest near you' card, making the full business name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, use a wider card, or truncate with an ellipsis and show the full name on tap or in a tooltip.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card displays a '-0%' discount badge, which is meaningless and suggests bad promotion data or a rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and validate promotion data before displaying it.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category chip is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visible scroll indicator or affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a horizontal scroll affordance such as a fade gradient, peek of the next item, or a scroll indicator.
